what.text: This page follows asylum seekers from Ukraine in Israel: people who have asked for international protection and are waiting for a decision.
At the end of 2025, UNHCR counted 436 Ukrainian asylum seekers in Israel, 1.6% of all asylum seekers from Ukraine.
Refugees from Ukraine, a separate group, live mostly in Germany, Poland, Czechia and the United Kingdom.

why.text: UCDP records armed conflict over Novorossiya territory in Ukraine from 2014 to 2022, and an interstate armed conflict between Russia and Ukraine from 2022 to 2025.
The main years of displacement in the data, 2016 to 2018, fall within the first of those conflicts.

when.text: UNHCR's series for this group starts in 2001 at 5 asylum seekers.
The figure was at its highest, 11507, at the end of 2017, and was much lower by 2025.

how.text: The sources don't say which routes people took or where they live in Israel.
Asylum seekers are counted separately from refugees, as year-end totals for Israel only.
